views.label: Main incident rail
views.note: Follow a correlated candidate through analyst review to a finalized case.

views.label: Insufficient evidence
views.note: An unsupported hypothesis waits for more evidence and returns to investigation when evidence arrives.

views.label: False-positive exit
views.note: Triage may conclude that the alert is benign without rewriting the source evidence.

cards.title: Candidate → Open
items: What: promote a correlated group into an accepted case; Input: scored evidence group; Output: open Incident.
Knowledge: Detection vs Correlation and Alert vs Incident.
Learn before: justify the threshold; Later — Future Extension: triage queues; Depth: Basic–Intermediate.

cards.title: Investigating → Triaged
items: What: review ordered evidence and assess priority; Input: incident timeline; Output: triage finding/severity.
Knowledge: evidence vs finding vs hypothesis, timeline, severity vs confidence.
Learn before: cite evidence for each finding; Later — Future Extension: formal playbooks; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Resolved → Closed
items: What: record the outcome and finalize the reviewable case; Input: triaged incident and resolution; Output: immutable closed record.
Knowledge: evidence traceability and analyst-friendly reporting.
Learn before: preserve facts and citations; Later — Future Extension: containment/recovery integrations; Depth: Beginner–Basic.

cards.title: Explicit Alternate Outcomes
items: Needs More Evidence is recoverable and returns to Investigating only when new evidence arrives
False Positive means a benign explanation was evidenced; raw events are not deleted
Reopened incidents are a Future Extension, not part of the MVP state machine
